### Model 1

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mixed-effects analysis of group differences in valence/arousal
# Long-format data: one row = one segment-level rating from one participant
#
# Fixed effects:
#   group * modality
#
# Random effects:
#   participant, story, story:segment
# ============================================================


# ----------------------------
# 1. Load packages
# ----------------------------
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # p-values for fixed effects
library(emmeans)    # estimated marginal means / pairwise comparisons
library(dplyr)
library(car)        # optional Type-III tests
library(readr)


# ----------------------------
# 2. Helper function
# ----------------------------
run_mixed_analysis <- function(data, outcome,equation) {
  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  # Descriptives by group x modality
  desc <- data %>%
    group_by(group, modality) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(desc)

  # Full model:
  # rating ~ group * modality + random intercepts
  form_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, equation)
  )

  model_full <- lmer(form_full, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  cat("\n--- Full model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model_full))

  cat("\n--- Type-III tests (optional) ---\n")
  print(car::Anova(model_full, type = 3))

  # ----------------------------
  # Estimated marginal means
  # ----------------------------

  # 3A. Age-group comparisons within each modality
  emm_group_by_mod <- emmeans(model_full, ~ group | modality)
  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means: group within modality ---\n")
  print(emm_group_by_mod)

  pair_group_by_mod <- pairs(emm_group_by_mod, adjust = "fdr")
  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons within modality (FDR) ---\n")
  print(pair_group_by_mod)

  # 3B. Modality comparisons within each age group
  emm_mod_by_group <- emmeans(model_full, ~ modality | group)
  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means: modality within group ---\n")
  print(emm_mod_by_group)

  pair_mod_by_group <- pairs(emm_mod_by_group, adjust = "fdr")
  cat("\n--- Pairwise modality comparisons within group (FDR) ---\n")
  print(pair_mod_by_group)

  # Convert to data frames for saving
  group_by_mod_df <- as.data.frame(pair_group_by_mod)
  mod_by_group_df  <- as.data.frame(pair_mod_by_group)

  # Optional: add effect sizes from contrasts if you want
  # (the estimate column is already the mean difference)
  group_by_mod_df$p_fdr <- p.adjust(group_by_mod_df$p.value, method = "fdr")
  mod_by_group_df$p_fdr  <- p.adjust(mod_by_group_df$p.value, method = "fdr")

  return(list(
    desc = desc,
    model_full = model_full,
    emm_group_by_mod = emm_group_by_mod,
    pair_group_by_mod = group_by_mod_df,
    emm_mod_by_group = emm_mod_by_group,
    pair_mod_by_group = mod_by_group_df
  ))
}

# ----------------------------
# 3. Prepare data
# ----------------------------
df <- df_ratings %>%
  filter(!is.na(V), !is.na(A)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("young", "middle", "old")),
    # change levels if your raw data uses different labels
    modality = factor(modality, levels = c("audio", "text"),
                      labels = c("listening", "reading")),
    subID = factor(subID),
    story = factor(narrative),
    segID = factor(segID),
    story_seg = interaction(story, segID, drop = TRUE, sep = "_")
  )

# If you already have modality coded as "listening" and "reading",
# replace the modality line above with:
# modality = factor(modality, levels = c("listening", "reading"))

# ----------------------------
# 4. Run analyses
# ----------------------------
equation <- " ~ group * modality + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
m1_valence_results  <- run_mixed_analysis(df, "V", equation)
m1_arousal_results  <- run_mixed_analysis(df, "A", equation)

library(glue)
# ----------------------------
# 5. Save outputs
# ----------------------------
Dir_output <- "X:/PROJECTS/ABC@UofSC/3-Experiments/NSF_valence/github/derivatives/behavioral/ACII"

write_csv(m1_valence_results$pair_group_by_mod, glue("{Dir_output}/model1_valence_group_within_modality.csv"))
write_csv(m1_valence_results$pair_mod_by_group,  glue("{Dir_output}/model1_valence_modality_within_group.csv"))
write_csv(m1_arousal_results$pair_group_by_mod,  glue("{Dir_output}/model1_arousal_group_within_modality.csv"))
write_csv(m1_arousal_results$pair_mod_by_group,   glue("{Dir_output}/model1_arousal_modality_within_group.csv"))

```

### Model 3
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mixed-effects analysis of age-group differences
# Separate models for audio and text
# Audio model includes voice as a fixed effect
#
# Outcome variables: V (valence), A (arousal)
# Random effects: participant, story, story:segment
# ============================================================

# ----------------------------
# 1. Load packages
# ----------------------------
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # p-values for fixed effects
library(emmeans)    # estimated marginal means / pairwise comparisons
library(dplyr)
library(car)        # optional Type-III tests
library(readr)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Prepare data
# ----------------------------
df <- df_ratings %>%
  filter(!is.na(V), !is.na(A)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("young", "middle", "old")),
    subID = factor(subID),
    story = factor(narrative),
    segID = factor(segID),
    story_seg = interaction(story, segID, drop = TRUE, sep = "_")
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3. Extract voice from audio column
#    voice is the prefix before the first "_"
# ----------------------------
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    voice = ifelse(
      !is.na(audio) & audio != "",
      sub("^([^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", as.character(audio)),
      NA
    ),
    voice = factor(voice)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4. Split data by modality
# ----------------------------
df_audio <- df %>% filter(modality == "audio")
df_text  <- df %>% filter(modality == "text")

# ----------------------------
# 5. Helper function for text model
# ----------------------------
run_text_mixed_analysis <- function(data, outcome) {
  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("TEXT MODEL | Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  desc <- data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(desc)

  # Full model: group effect only
  form_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ group + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)")
  )
  model_full <- lmer(form_full, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  cat("\n--- Full model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model_full))

  cat("\n--- Type-III tests ---\n")
  print(car::Anova(model_full, type = 3))

  # Omnibus test for group
  form_null <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ 1 + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)")
  )
  model_null <- lmer(form_null, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test for group effect ---\n")
  print(anova(model_null, model_full))

  # Estimated marginal means for group
  emm_group <- emmeans(model_full, ~ group)
  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for group ---\n")
  print(emm_group)

  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons (FDR) ---\n")
  pw_group <- pairs(emm_group, adjust = "fdr")
  print(pw_group)

  pw_group_df <- as.data.frame(pw_group)
  pw_group_df$p_fdr <- p.adjust(pw_group_df$p.value, method = "fdr")

  return(list(
    desc = desc,
    model_full = model_full,
    model_null = model_null,
    emm_group = emm_group,
    pairwise_group = pw_group_df
  ))
}

# ----------------------------
# 6. Helper function for audio model
#    includes voice as a fixed effect
# ----------------------------
run_audio_mixed_analysis <- function(data, outcome) {
  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("AUDIO MODEL | Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  desc <- data %>%
    group_by(group, voice) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(desc)

  # Full model: group + voice
  form_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ group + voice + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)")
  )
  model_full <- lmer(form_full, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  cat("\n--- Full model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model_full))

  cat("\n--- Type-III tests ---\n")
  print(car::Anova(model_full, type = 3))

  # Omnibus test for group (keep voice in model)
  form_null_group <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ voice + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)")
  )
  model_null_group <- lmer(form_null_group, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test for group effect ---\n")
  print(anova(model_null_group, model_full))

  # Omnibus test for voice (optional)
  form_null_voice <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ group + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)")
  )
  model_null_voice <- lmer(form_null_voice, data = data, REML = FALSE)

  cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test for voice effect ---\n")
  print(anova(model_null_voice, model_full))

  # Estimated marginal means for group
  emm_group <- emmeans(model_full, ~ group, )
  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for group ---\n")
  print(emm_group)

  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons (FDR) ---\n")
  pw_group <- pairs(emm_group, adjust = "fdr")
  print(pw_group)

  pw_group_df <- as.data.frame(pw_group)
  pw_group_df$p_fdr <- p.adjust(pw_group_df$p.value, method = "fdr")

  # Optional: voice means and pairwise comparisons
  emm_voice <- emmeans(model_full, ~ voice)
  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for voice ---\n")
  print(emm_voice)

  cat("\n--- Pairwise voice comparisons (FDR) ---\n")
  pw_voice <- pairs(emm_voice, adjust = "fdr")
  print(pw_voice)

  pw_voice_df <- as.data.frame(pw_voice)
  pw_voice_df$p_fdr <- p.adjust(pw_voice_df$p.value, method = "fdr")

  return(list(
    desc = desc,
    model_full = model_full,
    model_null_group = model_null_group,
    model_null_voice = model_null_voice,
    emm_group = emm_group,
    pairwise_group = pw_group_df,
    emm_voice = emm_voice,
    pairwise_voice = pw_voice_df
  ))
}

# ----------------------------
# 7. Run analyses for TEXT
# ----------------------------
text_V_results <- run_text_mixed_analysis(df_text, "V")
text_A_results <- run_text_mixed_analysis(df_text, "A")

# ----------------------------
# 8. Run analyses for AUDIO
# ----------------------------
audio_V_results <- run_audio_mixed_analysis(df_audio, "V")
audio_A_results <- run_audio_mixed_analysis(df_audio, "A")



# ----------------------------
# 9. Save outputs
# ----------------------------
write_csv(text_V_results$pairwise_group,   glue("{Dir_output}/model3_text_valence_group_pairs.csv"))
write_csv(text_A_results$pairwise_group,  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_text_arousal_group_pairs.csv"))

write_csv(audio_V_results$pairwise_group, glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_valence_group_pairs.csv"))
write_csv(audio_A_results$pairwise_group, glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_arousal_group_pairs.csv"))

write_csv(audio_V_results$pairwise_voice,  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_valence_voice_pairs.csv"))
write_csv(audio_A_results$pairwise_voice,  glue("{Dir_output}/model3_audio_arousal_voice_pairs.csv"))

```



### Model 4
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Modality comparison using mixed-effects models
#
# Main design:
#   presentation_sex = text, audio_male, audio_female
#
# Model:
#   rating ~ group * presentation_sex
#          + (1|subID)
#          + (1|story)
#          + (1|story_seg)
#
# Main contrast:
#   ((audio_male + audio_female) / 2) - text
#
# This keeps the full participant-level long-format data.
# ============================================================

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# ----------------------------
# 1. Prepare data
# ----------------------------

df <- df_ratings %>%
  filter(!is.na(V), !is.na(A)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("young", "middle", "old")),
    modality = factor(modality, levels = c("audio", "text")),
    subID = factor(subID),
    segID = factor(segID)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 2. Extract exact speaker from audio prefix
# ----------------------------
# Assumption:
#   audio column has the form:
#     speaker_storyname
#
# Example:
#   F01_story12
#   M03_story12
#
# speaker = prefix before first "_"
# story   = everything after first "_"
# ----------------------------
library(stringr)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      modality == "audio" ~ str_extract(as.character(audio), "^[^_]+"),
      modality == "text"  ~ NA_character_
    ),

    story = case_when(
      modality == "audio" ~ str_replace(as.character(audio), "^[^_]+_", ""),
      modality == "text"  ~ as.character(text)
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3. Map exact speaker to voice sex
# ----------------------------
# EDIT THIS MAPPING to match your actual 7 speaker labels.
#
# The names on the left must exactly match the extracted speaker labels.
# The values on the right should be "male" or "female".
# ----------------------------

speaker_to_sex <- c(
  "Allison" = "female",
  "Jacob" = "male",
  "Brandi" = "female",
  "Jack" = "male",
  "WavenetF" = "female",
  "WavenetB" = "male",
  "Jewell" = "female"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    voice_sex = case_when(
      modality == "audio" ~ unname(speaker_to_sex[speaker]),
      modality == "text"  ~ NA_character_
    ),

    story = factor(story),
    speaker = factor(speaker),
    voice_sex = factor(voice_sex, levels = c("male", "female")),

    story_seg = interaction(story, segID, drop = TRUE, sep = "_"),

    presentation_sex = case_when(
      modality == "text" ~ "text",
      modality == "audio" & voice_sex == "male" ~ "audio_male",
      modality == "audio" & voice_sex == "female" ~ "audio_female"
    ),

    presentation_sex = factor(
      presentation_sex,
      levels = c("text", "audio_male", "audio_female")
    )
  )

# Check that all audio rows received a valid sex label
cat("\n--- Speaker by voice sex ---\n")
print(table(df$speaker, df$voice_sex, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\n--- Presentation condition counts ---\n")
print(table(df$group, df$presentation_sex, useNA = "ifany"))

# Optional safety check
if (any(is.na(df$presentation_sex))) {
  stop("Some rows have missing presentation_sex. Check speaker_to_sex mapping.")
}

# ----------------------------
# 4. Helper function
# ----------------------------

run_modality_model <- function(data, outcome) {

  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  # Descriptives
  desc <- data %>%
    group_by(group, presentation_sex) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_ratings = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(subID),
      n_stories = n_distinct(story),
      n_story_segments = n_distinct(story_seg),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  cat("\n--- Descriptives ---\n")
  print(desc)

  # Mixed model
  form <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ group * presentation_sex + ",
      "(1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg)"
    )
  )

  model <- lmer(
    form,
    data = data,
    REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

  cat("\n--- Model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model))

  # Estimated marginal means for presentation within age group
  emm_pres <- emmeans(model, ~ presentation_sex | group)

  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means: presentation sex within group ---\n")
  print(emm_pres)

  # ----------------------------
  # Main modality contrast:
  #   average(audio_male, audio_female) - text
  # ----------------------------

  modality_contrast <- contrast(
    emm_pres,
    method = list(
      "audio_avg_minus_text" = c(
        text = -1,
        audio_male = 0.5,
        audio_female = 0.5
      )
    ),
    by = "group",
    adjust = "fdr"
  )

  cat("\n--- Main modality contrast within each group ---\n")
  print(summary(modality_contrast, infer = TRUE))

  # ----------------------------
  # Optional: male-audio vs text and female-audio vs text
  # ----------------------------

  voice_sex_specific <- contrast(
    emm_pres,
    method = list(
      "audio_male_minus_text" = c(
        text = -1,
        audio_male = 1,
        audio_female = 0
      ),
      "audio_female_minus_text" = c(
        text = -1,
        audio_male = 0,
        audio_female = 1
      ),
      "audio_female_minus_audio_male" = c(
        text = 0,
        audio_male = -1,
        audio_female = 1
      )
    ),
    by = "group",
    adjust = "fdr"
  )

  cat("\n--- Voice-sex-specific contrasts within each group ---\n")
  print(summary(voice_sex_specific, infer = TRUE))

  # ----------------------------
  # Group differences in the modality effect
  # ----------------------------

  modality_effect_group_comparison <- pairs(
    modality_contrast,
    by = NULL,
    adjust = "fdr"
  )

  cat("\n--- Pairwise group differences in modality effect ---\n")
  print(summary(modality_effect_group_comparison, infer = TRUE))

  return(list(
    desc = desc,
    model = model,
    emm_pres = emm_pres,
    modality_contrast = as.data.frame(summary(modality_contrast, infer = TRUE)),
    voice_sex_specific = as.data.frame(summary(voice_sex_specific, infer = TRUE)),
    modality_effect_group_comparison =
      as.data.frame(summary(modality_effect_group_comparison, infer = TRUE))
  ))
}

# ----------------------------
# 5. Run models for valence and arousal
# ----------------------------

valence_modality <- run_modality_model(df, "V")
arousal_modality <- run_modality_model(df, "A")

# ----------------------------
# 6. Save outputs
# ----------------------------

write_csv(
  valence_modality$modality_contrast,
   glue("{Dir_output}/model4_valence_audio_avg_minus_text_by_group.csv")
)

write_csv(
  arousal_modality$modality_contrast,
   glue("{Dir_output}/model4_arousal_audio_avg_minus_text_by_group.csv")
)

write_csv(
  valence_modality$voice_sex_specific,
   glue("{Dir_output}/model4_valence_voice_sex_specific_contrasts.csv")
)

write_csv(
  arousal_modality$voice_sex_specific,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model4_arousal_voice_sex_specific_contrasts.csv")
)

write_csv(
  valence_modality$modality_effect_group_comparison,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model4_valence_group_differences_in_modality_effect.csv")
)

write_csv(
  arousal_modality$modality_effect_group_comparison,
  glue("{Dir_output}/model4_arousal_group_differences_in_modality_effect.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 6. Optional: model comparison for the interaction
# ----------------------------
# This tests whether group x modality is needed
valence_no_interaction <- lmer(
  V ~ group + modality + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg),
  data = df, REML = FALSE
)

arousal_no_interaction <- lmer(
  A ~ group + modality + (1|subID) + (1|story) + (1|story_seg),
  data = df, REML = FALSE
)

cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test: interaction for valence ---\n")
print(anova(valence_no_interaction, valence_results))

cat("\n--- Likelihood-ratio test: interaction for arousal ---\n")
print(anova(arousal_no_interaction, arousal_results))

# ----------------------------
# 7. Optional: if you want a clean summary table
# ----------------------------
valence_group_tbl <- as.data.frame(valence_results$emm_group_by_mod)
arousal_group_tbl  <- as.data.frame(arousal_results$emm_group_by_mod)

write_csv(valence_group_tbl, "valence_emmeans_group_by_modality.csv")
write_csv(arousal_group_tbl, "arousal_emmeans_group_by_modality.csv")

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mixed-effects analysis of group differences in ratings
# Data: df_ratings imported from Python CSVs
# Outcomes: V (valence), A (arousal)
# Fixed effects: group, modality
# Random effects: participant, narrative, narrative:segment
# ============================================================


# Optional: if idx is the true participant identifier and subID is not
# then replace subID above with idx.
# df$subID <- factor(df$idx)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Helper function
# ----------------------------
run_lmer_group_analysis <- function(data, outcome) {
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Outcome:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")

  # Descriptives by group
  desc <- data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  print(desc)

  # Full model:
  # outcome ~ group + modality + (1|subID) + (1|narrative) + (1|story_seg)
  formula_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ group + modality + (1|subID) + (1|narrative) + (1|story_seg)")
  )

  model_full <- lmer(formula_full, data = data, REML = FALSE)
  cat("\n--- Full model summary ---\n")
  print(summary(model_full))

  # Null model without group
  formula_null <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ modality + (1|subID) + (1|narrative) + (1|story_seg)")
  )

  model_null <- lmer(formula_null, data = data, REML = FALSE)
  cat("\n--- Likelihood ratio test for group effect ---\n")
  print(anova(model_null, model_full))

  # Estimated marginal means for group
  emm_group <- emmeans(model_full, ~ group)
  cat("\n--- Estimated marginal means for group ---\n")
  print(emm_group)

  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons (Tukey-adjusted) ---\n")
  pw_group <- pairs(emm_group, adjust = "tukey")
  print(pw_group)

  # FDR correction on pairwise p-values
  pw_df <- as.data.frame(pw_group)
  pw_df$p_fdr <- p.adjust(pw_df$p.value, method = "fdr")
  cat("\n--- Pairwise group comparisons with FDR correction ---\n")
  print(pw_df)

  return(list(
    desc = desc,
    model_full = model_full,
    model_null = model_null,
    emm_group = emm_group,
    pairwise = pw_group,
    pairwise_fdr = pw_df
  ))
}

# ----------------------------
# 3. Valence analysis
# ----------------------------
valence_results <- run_lmer_group_analysis(df, "V")

# ----------------------------
# 4. Arousal analysis
# ----------------------------
arousal_results <- run_lmer_group_analysis(df, "A")

# ----------------------------
# 5. Optional: group-by-modality interaction
# ----------------------------
# If you also want to know whether group effects differ by modality:
model_interaction_V <- lmer(
  V ~ group * modality + (1|subID) + (1|narrative) + (1|story_seg),
  data = df, REML = FALSE
)
summary(model_interaction_V)

model_interaction_A <- lmer(
  A ~ group * modality + (1|subID) + (1|narrative) + (1|story_seg),
  data = df, REML = FALSE
)
summary(model_interaction_A)

# ----------------------------
# 6. Save results
# ----------------------------
sink("mixed_model_results.txt")

cat("VALENCE MODEL\n")
print(summary(valence_results$model_full))
cat("\nVALENCE OMNIBUS TEST\n")
print(anova(valence_results$model_null, valence_results$model_full))
cat("\nVALENCE PAIRWISE\n")
print(valence_results$pairwise_fdr)

cat("\n\nAROUSAL MODEL\n")
print(summary(arousal_results$model_full))
cat("\nAROUSAL OMNIBUS TEST\n")
print(anova(arousal_results$model_null, arousal_results$model_full))
cat("\nAROUSAL PAIRWISE\n")
print(arousal_results$pairwise_fdr)

cat("\n\nVALENCE GROUP x MODALITY MODEL\n")
print(summary(model_interaction_V))

cat("\n\nAROUSAL GROUP x MODALITY MODEL\n")
print(summary(model_interaction_A))

sink()
```
